name: AccelDiff EasyCache solver fork
plain: Forks core solvers with an EasyCache state object that accumulates a predicted-change estimate; while it stays under a threshold, model calls return x plus a cached output delta. This is in the sampler loop itself, not a model patch like core EasyCache nodes.
math: cache = denoised − x from the last real call. k = |Δdenoised|/|Δinput| between real calls. err += k·|x − x_prev|/|prev_output|. If err < threshold: denoised = x + cache. Else real call, err=0. First ret_steps and last step always real. Defaults threshold=0.025, ret_steps=5. Multi-eval solvers share the should_calc decision over one step.

providers.author: jiajianxie
providers.note: Also forks dpm_fast and dpm_adaptive via DPMSolver with final_step flags
